hints: Focus on the two clues together, the gas must both cause acid rain and be cleaned up by the converter.
Remember that catalytic converters remove carbon monoxide, unburnt hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides, but they actually produce carbon dioxide.
Think about which of those removed pollutants dissolves in rainwater to form an acid, nitric acid in this case.
walkthrough:
**Recall what a catalytic converter does**

Great start, let us think about the job of the converter. It turns harmful exhaust gases into less harmful ones.

Key reactions:
$$2\text{CO} + 2\text{NO} \rightarrow 2\text{CO}_2 + \text{N}_2$$
$$\text{C}_x\text{H}_y + (x + y/4)\text{O}_2 \rightarrow x\text{CO}_2 + (y/2)\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Recall which gases cause acid rain**

Now the second clue. Acid rain comes from non-metal oxides that dissolve to make acids. The two main culprits are sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides.

For nitrogen dioxide:
$$2\text{NO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow \text{HNO}_2 + \text{HNO}_3$$

**Match both conditions**

Let us put it together. Carbon monoxide and hydrocarbons are removed but do not cause acid rain. Carbon dioxide does not cause acid rain and is made, not removed. Only nitrogen dioxide fits both points, it is a nitrogen oxide removed by the converter and it forms nitric acid in rain.

options.A: Carbon dioxide is a product of the catalytic converter, not a gas removed by it. It contributes to global warming but it is not a major cause of acid rain.
options.B: Carbon monoxide is removed by the converter by oxidation to carbon dioxide, so it fits the second bullet. However it is very toxic but does not dissolve to form acid rain, so it fails the first bullet.
options.C: Unburnt hydrocarbon vapour is removed by the converter by oxidation to carbon dioxide and water. It can contribute to photochemical smog but it does not cause acid rain.
options.D: Nitrogen dioxide is a nitrogen oxide ($\text{NO}_x$) removed in the converter by reduction to nitrogen, $\text{N}_2$. If released, it dissolves in rain to form nitric acid, $\text{HNO}_3$, a cause of acid rain. It is the only option that satisfies both bullets.
